mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Singed's pursuit of life-giving knowledge fell short.

“A hindrance. Nothing more.”

Slowly generate a Shield of up to 15% max Health when near a turret or one of Heimerdinger's H-28 G Evolution Turrets.

“Goodness and gadgets! With the data we gathered, we can extend a helping hand even beyond Piltover.”

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger lobs a grenade at a location, dealing damage to enemy units, as well as stunning anyone directly hit and slowing surrounding units.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heimerdinger hurls a grenade that deals @Damage@ magic damage in an area and Slows by @SlowPercent.0*100@% for @SlowDuration@ seconds. Enemies in the center are also Stunned for @StunDuration@ seconds.

Hitting a champion fully charges nearby Turrets.

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>Eureka!</titleLeft><mainText>Heimerdinger has solved the problem of having enemies who are still alive. Using careful experimentation, he has adjusted their 'alive' status. FOR SCIENCE!</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

Hextech TurretHeimerdinger's Turrets are immune to Lifesteal and Spell Vamp but receive 40% extra damage from Towers and Champion melee attacks.

Turrets shut down 8 seconds after Heimerdinger leaves the area. Shut down Turrets take double damage from all sources. Source: @SourceName@

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger lays down a rapid-fire cannon turret equipped with a secondary pass-through beam attack (turrets deal half damage to towers).
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heimerdinger constructs a Turret that attacks nearby enemies. Heimerdinger can have @MaxTurrets@ turrets active at once. Turrets slowly build up charge. At max charge, they fire a stronger attack.

If Heimerdinger gets too far away, his Turrets will deactivate after 8 seconds.

This Ability has @MaxKits@ charges.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
Turrets prioritize attacking enemies Heimerdinger has recently damaged and enemies attacking Heimerdinger.

Turret Stats:
@TurretHealth@ Health
@Damage@ magic damage per regular shot
@DamageBeam@ magic damage per charged shot

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger invents an upgrade, causing his next spell to have increased effects.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heimerdinger upgrades his next non-ultimate Ability.

H-28Q Apex Turret: Place an upgraded Turret for 8 seconds that doesn't count towards Heimerdinger's max turrets, deals @QUltDamage@ magic damage per shot and @QUltDamageBeam@ magic damage per charged shot. Its attacks deal damage in an area, Slow by 25% for 2 seconds, and it is immune to crowd control.

Hextech Rocket Swarm: Fires 4 waves of rockets that each deal @WUltDamage@ magic damage. Champions and jungle monsters hit by additional rockets take reduced damage, and minions take increased damage. Max Damage: @WUltTotalDamage@ magic damage.

CH-3X Lightning Grenade: Throws a bouncing grenade that discharges three times, dealing @EUltDamage@ magic damage. The Stun and Slow areas are larger.

Recast: Cancel this Ability.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine:
The upgraded Ability has no cost.
Upgraded rockets deal 2000% damage to minions.

Apex Turret Stats:
@QUltTurretHealth@ Health
@RQTurretResists@ Armor
@RQTurretResists@ Magic Resist
@QUltDamage@ magic damage per regular shot
@QUltDamageBeam@ magic damage per charged shot

mBuff.mDescription: <titleLeft>H-28Q Apex Turret</titleLeft><mainText>Heimerdinger's Apex Turret is operational. It charges beams twice as fast, slows targets, has immunity to crowd control, has bonus health and damage, and its attacks have area of effect.</mainText><postScriptLeft>Source: @SourceName@</postScriptLeft>

mLocKeys.keySummary: Heimerdinger fires long-range rockets that converge on his cursor.
mLocKeys.keyTooltip:
Heimerdinger unleashes a barrage of @Rockets@ rockets that deal @Damage@ magic damage to the first enemy hit. Additional rocket hits deal reduced damage.

Max Damage: @TotalDamage@ magic damage.

Nearby Turrets gain 20% charge per rocket that hits a champion.
mLocKeys.keyTooltipExtendedBelowLine: <rules>Enemies hit by multiple rockets take <magicDamage>@ExtraHitDamage@ magic damage</magicDamage> beyond the first. Minions instead take <magicDamage>@ExtraHitDamageMinions@ magic damage</magicDamage> beyond the first</rules>
